abstract: A 36-year-old man visited the hospital complaining of painless swelling of the right scrotal contents. His left scrotal contents were absent in the scrotum. Right inguinal orchiectomy was performed on May 17, 1993 under the diagnosis of testicular tumor. The pathological diagnosis of the tumor was pure seminoma. Abdominal computed tomography (CT) and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) revealed the enlargement of para-aortic lymph nodes and there was a soft tissue signal in the left inguinal region which seemed to be the left testis in MRI. His serum testosterone level was low and gonadotropin level was high. The left orchiopexy was performed on June 24, 1993, but the left testis was finally removed because of methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA) infections. Radiation therapy was done against the metastatic lesion in the retroperitoneal lymph nodes and complete remission was obtained. The left undescended testis pathologically showed atrophy of germ cells but there was no appearance of atypia of Leydig cells or germ cells.
abstract_ja: 36歳男性が右陰嚢内容の無痛性腫脹を主訴に受診した。左陰嚢内容は陰嚢内に認められなかった。1993年5月17日、精巣腫瘍の診断で右鼡径精巣摘除術を施行した。病理診断は純粋セミノーマであった。腹部コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)と磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)では傍大動脈リンパ節の腫大を認め、MRIでは左鼡径部に軟部組織信号があり、左精巣と思われた。血清テストステロン値は低く、ゴナドトロピン値は高値であった。1993年6月24日に左精巣固定術を施行したが、メチシリン耐性黄色ブドウ球菌(MRSA)感染のため最終的に左精巣を摘除した。後腹膜リンパ節への転移病変に対して放射線療法を行い、完全寛解を得た。左停留精巣の病理所見では胚細胞の萎縮を認めたが、ライディッヒ細胞や胚細胞の異型所見は認めなかった。
